description:
Rear Garden	

T1	Magnolia × soulangeana	20% Crown Reduction - Reducing the height and spread of the tree by approximately 1-2m to tidy and contain, making both trees uniform.	Final height = 4m and final spread = 2m.

T2	Magnolia × soulangeana	20% Crown Reduction - Reducing the height and spread of the tree by approximately 1-2m to tidy and contain, making both trees uniform.	Final height = 4m and final spread = 2m.

T3	Fig tree (Ficus carica)	20% Crown Reduction - Reducing the height and spread of the tree by approximately 1-2m to make it easier to pick fruit. Cut overhang to neighbours back to boundary line. Ensure tree is sufficiently cut back over Patio/Lawn area as it is encroaching quite a bit. Final height = 3m and final spread = 4m.
